description: Angular component for managing OAuth2 client configurations in the Thingsboard UI, including form building, template initialization, and configuration handling.

classes.name: ClientComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent to handle OAuth2 client configuration, including form management, template handling, and configuration updates.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the reactive form for OAuth2 client data with validation.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates the form with data from an OAuth2Client entity.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Retrieves the provider name from the form.

methods.name: isCustomProvider
methods.description: Checks if the current provider is 'Custom'.

methods.name: initTemplates
methods.description: Initializes OAuth2 registration templates and sets default provider.

methods.name: changeMapperConfigType
methods.description: Adjusts the form controls based on the selected mapper type.

methods.name: formCustomGroup
methods.description: Creates a form group for custom mapper configuration.

methods.name: formBasicGroup
methods.description: Creates a form group for basic mapper configuration.

methods.name: setProviderDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets default values in the form based on the selected provider.
